title: HTML
description: Convert the natural language description into HTML code. Please provide only the HTML code without any extra content, comments, or markdown: 'Create a header with the title 'Welcome to My Website.' 'Add a navigation bar with links to Home, About, and Contact.' 'Insert an image of a sunset with an alt text of 'Beautiful Sunset.' 'Make a footer that includes copyright information.' 'Create a section that contains three articles with headings and paragraphs.' 'Add an unordered list of hobbies.
use-case: When im on sites where code development usually happens, and im describing my code in natural language, where I want to convert it to HTML

title: CSS
description: Convert the HTML code into CSS code. Please provide only the CSS code without any extra content, comments, or markdown: 'Set the background color of the body to blue.' 'Make all headings center aligned.' 'Add a margin of 20 pixels to paragraphs.' 'Change the font size of buttons to 16 pixels.' 'Apply a border of 1 pixel solid black to images.' 'Set the text color to white for all list items.'
use-case: When im on sites where code development usually happens, and i have some HTML code in the selected text/inputbox, where I want to convert it to CSS. This tool ONLY runs when I am working with real HTML code.

title: JavaScript
description: Convert the following natural language description into JavaScript code. Please provide only the JavaScript code without any extra content, comments, or markdown: 'Create a function that returns the square of a number.' 'Define a variable to store your favorite color.' 'Write a loop that counts from 1 to 10 and prints each number.' 'Make an array of fruits and log the second fruit.' 'Create an object to represent a car with properties for make and model.' 'Implement a function that checks if a number is even or odd.'
use-case: When im on sites where code development usually happens, and im describing my code in natural language, where I want to convert it to JavaScript

title: Complete email draft

title: Complete my code function
description: Reads my highlighted code function and complete the code for it, paying attention to the programming language and writing code in the appropriate language.
use-case: Runs when I have highlighted a programming function and when I am in programming IDE’s. This tool SHOULD be used when my highlighted code does not contain the contents of the function, so in other words, only when my highlighted code function is ONLY the function name, with the contents waiting to be programmed and added.
